pages.description: Alice sits in a puff-sleeved apron dress holding a potion bottle labeled Drink Me, beside a small cake with an Eat Me sign, a cute rabbit holding a pocket watch, and a grinning Cheshire Cat floating nearby. Bold black outlines with clean details make this page enjoyable to color using colored pencils or alcohol markers.
